title: Auto-Hide Panel elements that only requires hovering can still be triggered and interacted with while it's hidden by dragging and dropping desktop items underneath the Panel's hitboxes
line: Dropping a desktop file where a hidden auto-hide panel would be no longer pops up that panel's tooltips.
explanation: When a drag ends on Wayland, QtWayland synthesizes a button release that has no window, and QGuiApplication sends it, with a move to its position, to whichever top-level window topLevelAt() reports under the cursor. Qt doesn't know KWin is hiding the auto-hide panel, so the hidden panel got that move and release, its Qt Quick scene registered hover and tooltips such as a launcher's opened next to the invisible panel. PanelView now ignores mouse events while the auto-hide screen edge is active and no real input (pointer or drag enter, pen or touch) has reached the panel since it was hidden; a press that started in the panel keeps getting its events, and visible auto-hide and Dodge Windows panels are untouched.

commits.message:
shell: ignore stray mouse events on a panel hidden by auto-hide

At the end of a drag Qt sends a button release with no window to the
top-level window under the cursor, even if KWin is hiding it, so hidden
panels showed tooltips. Ignore those until real input reveals the panel.

BUG: 514219

media.caption: Pure master, left auto-hide panel hidden: other.txt dropped where the hidden Dolphin launcher is and the pointer left still: Dolphin's tooltip appears next to the invisible panel
Same drop with the fix: no tooltip, the panel stays hidden
Pure master, six drops alternating the Konsole and Dolphin launcher spots: a tooltip in all six
Same six drops with the fix: no tooltip in any of them

review.text: The root cause is QtWayland (a window-less release after a drag routed via topLevelAt), so a Plasma-side guard is reasonable, but this one is too broad. It swallows every mouse event on any AutoHide/DodgeWindows panel that has no Enter, including a visible Dodge-Windows panel, and mouse events Qt synthesizes from tablet/pen input, which may come without a QEvent::Enter. The 1/4 vs 0/6 repro is thin, though the log line confirms that the hidden panel receives the stray events.
changes: Only drop the events while the panel is actually hidden by auto-hide (e.g. the autohide screen edge is active), not whenever m_containsMouse is false
Test pen/tablet input on a revealed auto-hide panel, and dragging a task/launcher out of a revealed auto-hide panel (no stuck pressed state)
Report the QtWayland bug upstream and reference it in a comment
